item.anime_multiverse.core_aegis.lore: A bastion crystal: it turns the blows of foreign powers aside.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.aegis: Health and ward: more maximum health, and less damage from the damage types of other mods.
item.anime_multiverse.core_striker.lore: A war crystal: whatever you swing hits harder.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.strike: Weapon damage: more attack damage for any weapon; two pieces raise your hits, four deal a second damage type.
item.anime_multiverse.core_wellspring_ma: A spring of magicules, frozen into a gem.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.wellsp: Magicule regeneration every second while worn.
item.anime_multiverse.core_wellspring_au: A spring of aura, frozen into a gem.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.wellsp: Aura regeneration every second while worn.
item.anime_multiverse.core_wellspring_ki: A spring of Ki, frozen into a gem.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.wellsp: Ki regeneration every second while worn (Ki is the magicule of this mod; Saiyans get more).
item.anime_multiverse.core_wellspring_ni: A hollow in the shape of a gem: it takes away what holds a caster back.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.wellsp: Nihility: active skill cooldowns fall faster; four pieces wipe a harmful effect every second.
item.anime_multiverse.core_ascendant.lor: A crystal of growth: what you defeat makes you more.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.ascend: Progression: kills add a share of the victim's EP to your base EP (Telesma and Malice of Tensura No Index are not wired yet).
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_core.drop: Paid once per boss hall by the Decennial bosses of floor 250 and deeper.
tooltip.anime_multiverse.boss_set.bonus: Two and four pieces of one set add a bonus; sets worn together share a cap.
